pages.text: After a gentle rain, <name> looked up and gasped. A bright rainbow stretched across the sky, all shiny and colorful. “Wow! How did that appear?” he wondered.
A friendly cloud floated nearby. “Hello, <name>! Rainbows are made when sunlight meets raindrops,” it said softly.
A few playful sunbeams peeked through the clouds. “We shine through the drops and bend a little,” they giggled. “That’s how colors appear in the sky!”
Even some talking raindrops joined in. “We help the sunlight split into red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet,” they sang. “See how we shine together?”

<name> watched carefully as the rainbow shimmered and arched across the sky. He tried to count the colors and traced each one with his finger in the air. “So sunlight and water make all the pretty colors,” he said, smiling.
He stood in the garden, marveling at the rainbow and feeling happy that now he understood a little bit of the magic behind it. Happily ever after.
